text:
No, there's no cancellation fee and no minimum term for Plant Club. You can cancel from "Account" > "Subscriptions."

Timing matters: Plant Club is charged on the 25th of the previous month. If you cancel before the 25th, it affects your next box. If you cancel on or after the 25th, the change applies to the following month's box. An already-billed box isn't refunded on cancellation and will still be sent.

If you'd rather not cancel outright, you can also skip a month or pause for up to 3 months from the same page.
